result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I'd recommend **Dropbox Sign, signNow, or PandaDoc**, depending on how you use contracts and agreements.

You don't necessarily need an expensive enterprise platform. The best solution should make it easy to send documents, collect signatures, track who has signed, and store completed agreements.

## My top 5 e-signature platforms for 2026

![PandaDoc Review: Sign, Seal, Deliver](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/0MUKV24vOJ8Fy84anuzrEeDfSf0kpDjVQFizvzFH_No27CWsxijbo2OMMlOGpvgS85vZB3wg04yrL3uUEA8HfUdyjeWSSz3aH8VUzmHL1gINYfR2lzt9WJR1seELOV2zEpePqA9WPggyXDEs9xtNtG6ptm3fJ7rmZx4q6N4W7fYpmzjZfQx9dTipSbsTdrj3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign** (Best overall for small business)

Previously HelloSign

- Very easy to use.
- Reusable templates and signature requests.
- Automatic reminders and signing notifications.
- Good Dropbox integration.
- Paid plans offer unlimited signature requests.

**Starting price\:** Approximately US\$15/month.

[Visit Dropbox Sign](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![Best e-signature software | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/wmbNwQd5sZcCQM_y8xDHl0CPe7pgdwCT-krxdtJ31tc_1PKqy7PiBHAl_-Gd913WdMSfKG4tvcbm87CrehlVzyh0S_XfsJoy8bGchL0mjaA3hnz0pBJgnLcUXZcQanS1poRpGWtqsda_EXu0W3Y1sz9Tm8p7il83hsR4mOfYqnnCRPXfp1UL4Ot3PT4uhG1W?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. signNow**

(Best budget option)

- Affordable for small teams.
- Templates and automated workflows.
- Multiple signers.
- Document tracking and audit trails.

**Starting price\:** Approximately US\$8/user/month with annual billing.

[Visit signNow](https://www.signnow.com/)

---

![PandaDoc buys Denario for consolidated document and payment workflow offering](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nMZU-ikvjF7B27p2YRYbwMFVYldny8ofYsWDYYkqTXdGfrk-N9sresjiQS7_N5GL_z3bC2xtBlASA1wbjcPGc7QwN2zoEnDhBBAByuwL6PooRYdhb5Xb7bjGtsls49X_kKuOQ8O8ieH---UeiE5fGOQC1qFIRtUd6uc0-JR89a70cw5k0Vpz1IUhRMFOX01b?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PandaDoc**

(Best for sales and contracts)

- Create professional proposals and contracts.
- Collect electronic signatures.
- Track when customers open documents.
- Templates, pricing tables and payment integrations.

**Starting price\:** Approximately US\$19/user/month annually.

[Visit PandaDoc](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![ドキュサイン / Docusign について](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xyLq-c8NsrpmXngTDQOlq_nQ-hdoipi8LNAM0PriPm9OXbxzSMFpxHq4mX20RE5oKykXn_ebymihRHVC-xJF-ftlT3muOwPqVZr1LnypOPP6tZDIkDq6IjuWnsebSgjW-6slAQlpUZa-Wz9woFg0UDt6Xeug0D4ulHXJQLs86h2xGptBRDNSUfxqteGaxXDR?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. DocuSign**

(Best for established businesses)

- Widely recognized by customers and partners.
- Strong integrations.
- Advanced signing workflows.
- Good document tracking and audit records.

**Starting price\:** Approximately US\$10–15/month for entry-level individual plans, depending on billing.

[Visit DocuSign](https://www.docusign.com/)

---

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Solutions for business Transaction New](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/boFV63978924LtJqDW6sL1JIitAIaS-BthRNk192q0PHK-HvHdZBMxqDjDCO72LE2oPF1ayxecsE94Q-YPvxHO-S7Mi38P9TmXNhPAUlm7-8leU4NJBCSUCriipzFK7eQRBF1P54X7oN4viJGvAqlvPFeHJwJMDSU5H8EIj-uBFDS8q0gO8ZF29lIfJEU-lB?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Adobe Acrobat Sign**
**Best for PDF documents**

- PDF editing and signing.
- Professional document management.
- Microsoft 365 integration.
- Good for businesses already using Adobe Acrobat.

**Starting price\:** Approximately US\$16.99/month for certain plans.

[Visit Adobe Acrobat Sign](https://www.adobe.com/acrobat/business/e-sign.html)

## My recommendation

| Your business needs | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Simple customer contracts | Dropbox Sign |
| Lowest-cost signing solution | signNow |
| Sales proposals and agreements | PandaDoc |
| Widely recognized platform | DocuSign |
| PDF-heavy workflow | Adobe Sign |
